description: CV expander for C1-COMP, giving voltage control of its ratio, threshold, release and dry/wet mix

params.text: Attenuverter on the ratio CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the threshold CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the release CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the mix CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added

inputs.text: Shifts the ratio on C1-COMP, ±10V covering the whole knob with the attenuverter fully open, added to the RATIO knob and clamped to its travel
Shifts the threshold on C1-COMP, ±10V covering the whole 30dB range with the attenuverter fully open, added to the THRESHOLD knob and clamped to -20dB to +10dB
Shifts the release time on C1-COMP, ±10V covering nearly the whole knob with the attenuverter fully open, added to the RELEASE knob and clamped to 89% of its travel
Shifts the dry/wet mix on C1-COMP, ±10V covering the whole 0% to 100% range with the attenuverter fully open, added to the DRY/WET knob and clamped to that range

notes: The module does nothing unless C1-COMP is immediately to its left.
Every attenuverter is at 0% when the module is added, so all four jacks do nothing until one is turned up.
C1-COMP ignores the ratio, threshold and release CVs while its bypass button is on; the mix CV is read before the bypass test but has nothing to act on.
The dots either side of the X in the title fade from white to amber once C1-COMP is found on the left.
